136: func (r *SQLiteRepository) AcknowledgeCancellation(ctx context.Context, fence Fence) (Snapshot, bool, error) {
137: 	if ctx == nil {
138: 		ctx = context.Background()
139: 	}
140: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
141: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
142: 	}
143: 	now := r.now()
144: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
145: 	if err != nil {
146: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack_begin", "begin cancellation acknowledgement failed", err)
147: 	}
148: 	defer tx.Rollback()
149: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
150: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
151: 	}
152: 	current, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
153: 	if err != nil {
154: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
155: 	}
156: 	if current.Terminal != nil || current.Cancellation.State == CancellationAcknowledged {
157: 		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
158: 			return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack_read_commit", "finish cancellation acknowledgement read failed", err)
159: 		}
160: 		return current, false, nil
161: 	}
162: 	if current.Cancellation.State != CancellationRequested {
163: 		return Snapshot{}, false, runError(CodeConflict, "cancel_ack", fence.RunID, "cancellation has not been requested", false, nil)
164: 	}
165: 	sequence := current.LastSequence + 1
166: 	payload, _ := marshalBounded(map[string]string{"state": string(CancellationAcknowledged)}, MaxSafeValueBytes)
167: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, payload_json)
168: VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'cancellation', ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(fence.AttemptID), payload); err != nil {
169: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack_event", "persist cancellation acknowledgement event failed", err)
170: 	}
171: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
172: UPDATE runs SET cancellation_state = ?, cancellation_acknowledged_at = ?, updated_at = ?, last_sequence = ?
173: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND cancellation_state = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND last_sequence = ?`,
174: 		string(CancellationAcknowledged), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), sequence, string(fence.RunID), string(fence.AttemptID),
175: 		string(CancellationRequested), current.LastSequence)
176: 	if err != nil {
177: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack", "persist cancellation acknowledgement failed", err)
178: 	}
179: 	if changed, err := result.RowsAffected(); err != nil || changed != 1 {
180: 		return Snapshot{}, false, runError(CodeStaleFence, "cancel_ack", fence.RunID, "cancellation acknowledgement lost its fence", false, err)
181: 	}
182: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
183: 	if err != nil {
184: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
185: 	}
186: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
187: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack_commit", "commit cancellation acknowledgement failed", err)
188: 	}
189: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
190: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run cancellation acknowledged",
191: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
192: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: fmt.Sprint(sequence)}, LogField{Key: "cancellation_state", Value: string(snapshot.Cancellation.State)})
193: 	return snapshot, true, nil
194: }

196: func (r *SQLiteRepository) List(ctx context.Context, query Query) (Page, error) {
197: 	limit := query.Limit
198: 	if limit == 0 {
199: 		limit = 50
200: 	}
201: 	if limit < 1 || limit > 200 {
202: 		return Page{}, invalidField("query.limit", "must be between 1 and 200")
203: 	}
204: 	clauses := []string{"1=1"}
205: 	args := make([]any, 0, 8)
206: 	if len(query.Lifecycle) > 0 {
207: 		parts := make([]string, 0, len(query.Lifecycle))
208: 		for _, lifecycle := range query.Lifecycle {
209: 			if !lifecycle.IsValid() {
210: 				return Page{}, invalidField("query.lifecycle", "contains an unknown state")
211: 			}
212: 			parts = append(parts, "?")
213: 			args = append(args, string(lifecycle))
214: 		}
215: 		clauses = append(clauses, "lifecycle IN ("+strings.Join(parts, ",")+")")
216: 	}
217: 	for column, value := range map[string]string{
218: 		"target_kind": query.TargetKind, "project_id": query.Project, "sprint_id": query.Sprint, "study_id": query.Study,
219: 	} {
220: 		if value != "" {
221: 			clauses = append(clauses, column+" = ?")
222: 			args = append(args, value)
223: 		}
224: 	}
225: 	if query.After != "" {
226: 		cursor, err := decodeRunCursor(query.After)
227: 		if err != nil {
228: 			return Page{}, err
229: 		}
230: 		clauses = append(clauses, "(updated_at < ? OR (updated_at = ? AND run_id < ?))")
231: 		args = append(args, cursor.UpdatedAt, cursor.UpdatedAt, string(cursor.RunID))
232: 	}
233: 	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT run_id, updated_at FROM runs WHERE `+strings.Join(clauses, " AND ")+` ORDER BY updated_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT ?`, append(args, limit+1)...)
234: 	if err != nil {
235: 		return Page{}, classifyStoreError("list", "list runs failed", err)
236: 	}
237: 	defer rows.Close()
238: 	type listedRun struct {
239: 		id        RunID
240: 		updatedAt string
241: 	}
242: 	listed := make([]listedRun, 0, limit+1)
243: 	for rows.Next() {
244: 		var item listedRun
245: 		if err := rows.Scan(&item.id, &item.updatedAt); err != nil {
246: 			return Page{}, classifyStoreError("list_scan", "decode run list failed", err)
247: 		}
248: 		listed = append(listed, item)
249: 	}
250: 	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
251: 		return Page{}, classifyStoreError("list_rows", "read run list failed", err)
252: 	}
253: 	page := Page{Runs: make([]Snapshot, 0, min(limit, len(listed)))}
254: 	if len(listed) > limit {
255: 		page.NextCursor = encodeRunCursor(runCursor{UpdatedAt: listed[limit-1].updatedAt, RunID: listed[limit-1].id})
256: 		listed = listed[:limit]
257: 	}
258: 	for _, item := range listed {
259: 		snapshot, err := r.Snapshot(ctx, item.id)
260: 		if err != nil {
261: 			return Page{}, err
262: 		}
263: 		page.Runs = append(page.Runs, snapshot)
264: 	}
265: 	return page, nil
266: }

268: type runCursor struct {
269: 	UpdatedAt string `json:"updated_at"`
270: 	RunID     RunID  `json:"run_id"`
271: }
272: 
273: func encodeRunCursor(cursor runCursor) string {
274: 	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(cursor)
275: 	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(encoded)
276: }
277: 
278: func decodeRunCursor(value string) (runCursor, error) {
279: 	encoded, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(value)
280: 	if err != nil || len(encoded) > 1024 {
281: 		return runCursor{}, invalidField("query.after", "is not a valid opaque cursor")
282: 	}
283: 	var cursor runCursor
284: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &cursor); err != nil || cursor.UpdatedAt == "" || cursor.RunID.Validate() != nil {
285: 		return runCursor{}, invalidField("query.after", "is not a valid opaque cursor")
286: 	}
287: 	if _, err := parseTime(cursor.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
288: 		return runCursor{}, invalidField("query.after", "is not a valid opaque cursor")
289: 	}
290: 	return cursor, nil
291: }

293: type reconciliationCandidate struct {
294: 	runID      RunID
295: 	attemptID  AttemptID
296: 	ownerID    string
297: 	generation uint64
298: 	process    ProcessIdentity
299: }

301: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, probe ProcessProbe, opts ReconcileOptions) (ReconcileReport, error) {
302: 	if probe == nil {
303: 		return ReconcileReport{}, invalidField("process_probe", "is required")
304: 	}
305: 	grace := opts.Grace
306: 	if grace == 0 {
307: 		grace = ReconciliationGrace
308: 	}
309: 	if grace < 0 {
310: 		return ReconcileReport{}, invalidField("reconciliation.grace", "must not be negative")
311: 	}
312: 	limit := opts.Limit
313: 	if limit == 0 {
314: 		limit = DefaultReconcileBatch
315: 	}
316: 	if limit < 1 || limit > MaximumReconcileBatch {
317: 		return ReconcileReport{}, invalidField("reconciliation.limit", fmt.Sprintf("must be between 1 and %d", MaximumReconcileBatch))
318: 	}
319: 	report := ReconcileReport{Decisions: make([]ReconcileDecision, 0, limit)}
320: 	acceptedPredicate, acceptedArgs := r.expiredTimestampPredicate("accepted_at", grace)
321: 	unclaimedRows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `
322: SELECT run_id FROM runs
323: WHERE terminal_outcome IS NULL AND current_attempt_id IS NULL AND `+acceptedPredicate+`
324: ORDER BY accepted_at ASC, run_id ASC LIMIT ?`, append(acceptedArgs, limit)...)
325: 	if err != nil {
326: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "scan unclaimed runs failed", err)
327: 	}
328: 	var unclaimed []RunID
329: 	for unclaimedRows.Next() {
330: 		var runID RunID
331: 		if err := unclaimedRows.Scan(&runID); err != nil {
332: 			unclaimedRows.Close()
333: 			return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "decode unclaimed run failed", err)
334: 		}
335: 		unclaimed = append(unclaimed, runID)
336: 	}
337: 	if err := unclaimedRows.Close(); err != nil {
338: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "close unclaimed run scan failed", err)
339: 	}
340: 	for _, runID := range unclaimed {
341: 		won, err := r.reconcileUnclaimed(ctx, runID)
342: 		if err != nil {
343: 			return report, err
344: 		}
345: 		if !won {
346: 			continue
347: 		}
348: 		report.Scanned++
349: 		report.Terminal++
350: 		decision := "owner_never_claimed_after_grace"
351: 		candidate := reconciliationCandidate{runID: runID}
352: 		_ = r.recordReconciliation(ctx, candidate, "terminal_proposal", decision)
353: 		report.Decisions = append(report.Decisions, ReconcileDecision{RunID: runID, Action: "terminal_proposal", Decision: decision})
354: 	}
355: 	remaining := limit - report.Scanned
356: 	if remaining == 0 {
357: 		r.finishReconciliationLog(ctx, &report)
358: 		return report, nil
359: 	}
360: 	predicate, predicateArgs := r.expiredLeasePredicate(grace)
361: 	queryArgs := append(predicateArgs, remaining)
362: 	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `
363: SELECT runs.run_id, attempts.attempt_id, attempts.owner_id, attempts.fencing_generation,
364:        attempts.host_digest, attempts.boot_id, attempts.pid, attempts.process_birth_token
365: FROM runs JOIN attempts ON attempts.attempt_id = runs.current_attempt_id
366: WHERE runs.terminal_outcome IS NULL AND `+predicate+`
367: ORDER BY attempts.lease_expires_at ASC, runs.run_id ASC LIMIT ?`, queryArgs...)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "scan expired run owners failed", err)
370: 	}
371: 	var candidates []reconciliationCandidate
372: 	for rows.Next() {
373: 		var candidate reconciliationCandidate
374: 		if err := rows.Scan(&candidate.runID, &candidate.attemptID, &candidate.ownerID, &candidate.generation,
375: 			&candidate.process.HostDigest, &candidate.process.BootID, &candidate.process.PID, &candidate.process.BirthToken); err != nil {
376: 			rows.Close()
377: 			return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "decode expired run owner failed", err)
378: 		}
379: 		candidates = append(candidates, candidate)
380: 	}
381: 	if err := rows.Close(); err != nil {
382: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "close expired owner scan failed", err)
383: 	}
384: 	report.Scanned += len(candidates)
385: 	for _, candidate := range candidates {
386: 		observed, probeErr := probe.Probe(ctx, candidate.process.PID)
387: 		decision, outcome := reconcileProcessDecision(candidate.process, observed, probeErr)
388: 		action := "terminal_proposal"
389: 		if outcome == "" {
390: 			action = "mark_stalled"
391: 			if err := r.markStalled(ctx, candidate); err != nil {
392: 				if errors.Is(err, ErrTerminal) || errors.Is(err, ErrStaleFence) {
393: 					continue
394: 				}
395: 				return report, err
396: 			}
397: 			report.Stalled++
398: 		} else {
399: 			fence := Fence{RunID: candidate.runID, AttemptID: candidate.attemptID, OwnerID: candidate.ownerID, FencingGeneration: candidate.generation}
400: 			_, won, err := r.ProposeTerminal(ctx, fence, TerminalProposal{Outcome: outcome, Reason: decision, ProposedBy: "reconciler"})
401: 			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, ErrTerminal) && !errors.Is(err, ErrStaleFence) {
402: 				return report, err
403: 			}
404: 			if won {
405: 				report.Terminal++
406: 				if outcome == TerminalCleanupUncertain {
407: 					report.Uncertain++
408: 				}
409: 			}
410: 		}
411: 		_ = r.recordReconciliation(ctx, candidate, action, decision)
412: 		report.Decisions = append(report.Decisions, ReconcileDecision{RunID: candidate.runID, AttemptID: candidate.attemptID, Action: action, Decision: decision})
413: 	}
414: 	r.finishReconciliationLog(ctx, &report)
415: 	return report, nil
416: }

418: func (r *SQLiteRepository) finishReconciliationLog(ctx context.Context, report *ReconcileReport) {
419: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run reconciliation completed",
420: 		LogField{Key: "reconciliation_scanned", Value: fmt.Sprint(report.Scanned)},
421: 		LogField{Key: "reconciliation_stalled", Value: fmt.Sprint(report.Stalled)},
422: 		LogField{Key: "reconciliation_terminal", Value: fmt.Sprint(report.Terminal)},
423: 		LogField{Key: "reconciliation_uncertain", Value: fmt.Sprint(report.Uncertain)})
424: 	r.metrics.reconciliations.Add(1)
425: }

427: func (r *SQLiteRepository) reconcileUnclaimed(ctx context.Context, runID RunID) (wonResult bool, resultErr error) {
428: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
429: 	defer func() { r.metrics.terminal.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
430: 	now := r.now()
431: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
432: 	if err != nil {
433: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_begin", "begin unclaimed reconciliation failed", err)
434: 	}
435: 	defer tx.Rollback()
436: 	current, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, runID)
437: 	if err != nil {
438: 		if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
439: 			return false, nil
440: 		}
441: 		return false, err
442: 	}
443: 	if current.Terminal != nil || current.CurrentAttemptID != "" {
444: 		return false, nil
445: 	}
446: 	sequence := current.LastSequence + 1
447: 	reason := "owner_never_claimed_after_grace"
448: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(map[string]string{"outcome": string(TerminalInterrupted), "reason": reason}, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
449: 	if err != nil {
450: 		return false, err
451: 	}
452: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, payload_json)
453: VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'terminal', ?)`, string(runID), sequence, formatTime(now), payload); err != nil {
454: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_event", "persist unclaimed terminal event failed", err)
455: 	}
456: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE runs SET lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, finished_at = ?, updated_at = ?, last_sequence = ?,
457: terminal_outcome = ?, terminal_reason = ?, terminal_at = ?, terminal_proposed_by = 'reconciler'
458: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
459: 		string(LifecycleInterrupted), string(LivenessTerminal), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), sequence,
460: 		string(TerminalInterrupted), reason, formatTime(now), string(runID))
461: 	if err != nil {
462: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_cas", "persist unclaimed terminal state failed", err)
463: 	}
464: 	changed, err := result.RowsAffected()
465: 	if err != nil {
466: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_cas", "inspect unclaimed terminal state failed", err)
467: 	}
468: 	if changed != 1 {
469: 		return false, nil
470: 	}
471: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
472: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_commit", "commit unclaimed reconciliation failed", err)
473: 	}
474: 	r.notify(runID, sequence)
475: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "unclaimed run reconciled",
476: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(runID)}, LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: fmt.Sprint(sequence)},
477: 		LogField{Key: "terminal_outcome", Value: string(TerminalInterrupted)})
478: 	return true, nil
479: }
480: 
481: func reconcileProcessDecision(expected, observed ProcessIdentity, probeErr error) (string, TerminalOutcome) {
482: 	if errors.Is(probeErr, ErrProcessNotFound) {
483: 		return "owner_process_missing_after_grace", TerminalInterrupted
484: 	}
485: 	if probeErr != nil {
486: 		return "owner_process_identity_uncertain_after_grace", TerminalCleanupUncertain
487: 	}
488: 	if expected.HostDigest == "" || expected.BootID == "" || expected.BirthToken == "" || observed.HostDigest == "" || observed.BootID == "" || observed.BirthToken == "" {
489: 		return "owner_process_identity_incomplete_after_grace", TerminalCleanupUncertain
490: 	}
491: 	if expected.HostDigest != observed.HostDigest || expected.BootID != observed.BootID || expected.PID != observed.PID || expected.BirthToken != observed.BirthToken {
492: 		return "owner_process_birth_mismatch_after_grace", TerminalInterrupted
493: 	}
494: 	return "exact_owner_process_still_live_but_lease_expired", ""
495: }

497: func (r *SQLiteRepository) markStalled(ctx context.Context, candidate reconciliationCandidate) error {
498: 	result, err := r.db.ExecContext(ctx, `
499: UPDATE runs SET liveness = ?, updated_at = ?
500: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,

23: // sanitizeEventDraft is the final storage gate. Producers may only submit
24: // bounded product-owned fields; raw payloads, prompts, arbitrary diagnostics,
25: // credentials, and unrestricted paths are replaced with explicit omission.
26: func sanitizeEventDraft(input EventDraft) EventDraft {
27: 	out := EventDraft{
28: 		Type: input.Type, Scope: input.Scope, Stage: safeEventValue(input.Stage, MaxTargetFieldBytes),
29: 		Task: safeEventValue(input.Task, MaxTargetFieldBytes), Kind: safeEventValue(input.Kind, MaxSafeValueBytes),
30: 		Tool: safeEventValue(input.Tool, MaxSafeValueBytes), Action: safeEventValue(input.Action, MaxSafeValueBytes),
31: 		Reason: safeEventValue(input.Reason, MaxSafeValueBytes), Detail: safeEventValue(input.Detail, MaxSafeValueBytes), Lifecycle: input.Lifecycle,
32: 		Payload: make(map[string]string), Omission: cloneOmission(input.Omission),
33: 	}
34: 	omitted := uint64(0)
35: 	for key, value := range input.Payload {
36: 		if _, ok := allowedEventPayloadFields[key]; !ok || sensitiveEventField(key) || unsafeEventValue(value) {
37: 			omitted++
38: 			continue
39: 		}
40: 		if len(value) > MaxSafeValueBytes {
41: 			omitted++
42: 			continue
43: 		}
44: 		out.Payload[key] = safeEventValue(value, MaxSafeValueBytes)
45: 	}
46: 	if out.Stage != input.Stage || out.Task != input.Task {
47: 		omitted++
48: 	}
49: 	if omitted > 0 {
50: 		mergeOmission(&out, "unsafe event detail omitted", omitted, nil, nil)
51: 	}
52: 	encoded, err := json.Marshal(out)
53: 	if err != nil || len(encoded) > MaxEncodedEventBytes {
54: 		return EventDraft{
55: 			Type:     EventWarning,
56: 			Payload:  map[string]string{"code": "event_detail_oversize", "reason": "event detail exceeded durable limit"},
57: 			Omission: &Omission{Reason: "oversize event detail omitted", Count: max(omitted, 1)},
58: 		}
59: 	}
60: 	return out
61: }

63: func mergeOmission(draft *EventDraft, reason string, count uint64, first, last *time.Time) {
64: 	if draft.Omission == nil {
65: 		draft.Omission = &Omission{Reason: reason, Count: count, FirstAt: first, LastAt: last}
66: 		return
67: 	}
68: 	draft.Omission.Count += count
69: 	if draft.Omission.Reason == "" {
70: 		draft.Omission.Reason = reason
71: 	}
72: 	if draft.Omission.FirstAt == nil {

75: 	if last != nil {

102: 	}

410: 			return Snapshot{}, err
411: 		}
412: 	}
413: 	if err := runID.Validate(); err != nil {
414: 		return Snapshot{}, err
415: 	}
416: 	correlation, err := marshalBounded(input.Correlation, MaxSafeValueBytes*8)
417: 	if err != nil {
418: 		return Snapshot{}, err
419: 	}
420: 	now := r.now()
421: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
422: 	if err != nil {
423: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
424: 			return Snapshot{}, ctxErr
425: 		}
426: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept_begin", "begin durable acceptance failed", err)
427: 	}
428: 	defer tx.Rollback()
429: 	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
430: INSERT INTO runs (
431:     run_id, target_kind, operation_kind, project_id, sprint_id, study_id, stage_id, task_id,
432:     lifecycle, liveness, record_state, accepted_at, updated_at, correlation_json,
433:     product_status, confirmation_digest, cancellation_state
434: ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
435: 		string(runID), input.Target.Kind, input.Target.Operation, input.Target.Project, input.Target.Sprint,
436: 		input.Target.Study, input.Target.Stage, input.Target.Task, string(LifecycleAccepted), string(LivenessUnknown),
437: 		string(RecordFull), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), correlation, input.ProductStatus,
438: 		input.ConfirmationDigest, string(CancellationNone))
439: 	if err != nil {
440: 		if isConstraint(err) {
441: 			return Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "accept", runID, "run identity or acceptance key already exists", false, err)
442: 		}
443: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept", "persist durable acceptance failed", err)
444: 	}
445: 	if input.OperationAlias != "" {
446: 		if len(input.OperationAlias) > MaxSafeValueBytes || strings.ContainsAny(input.OperationAlias, "\x00\r\n") {
447: 			return Snapshot{}, invalidField("operation_alias", "must be a bounded opaque value")
448: 		}
449: 		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO operation_aliases (alias_id, run_id, alias_kind, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'operation', ?)`, input.OperationAlias, string(runID), formatTime(now)); err != nil {
450: 			if isConstraint(err) {
451: 				return Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "accept_alias", runID, "operation alias already exists", false, err)
452: 			}
453: 			return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept_alias", "persist operation alias failed", err)
454: 		}
455: 	}
456: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, runID)
457: 	if err != nil {
458: 		return Snapshot{}, err
459: 	}
460: 	if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
461: 		return Snapshot{}, err
462: 	}
463: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
464: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept_commit", "commit durable acceptance failed", err)
465: 	}
466: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run accepted",
467: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(runID)}, LogField{Key: "target_kind", Value: input.Target.Kind},
468: 		LogField{Key: "operation", Value: input.Target.Operation}, LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
469: 	return snapshot, nil
470: }

472: func (r *SQLiteRepository) ResolveOperationAlias(ctx context.Context, alias string) (Snapshot, error) {
473: 	if strings.TrimSpace(alias) == "" || len(alias) > MaxSafeValueBytes || strings.ContainsAny(alias, "\x00\r\n") {
474: 		return Snapshot{}, invalidField("operation_alias", "must be a bounded opaque value")
475: 	}
476: 	var runID RunID
477: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT run_id FROM operation_aliases WHERE alias_id = ?`, alias).Scan(&runID); err != nil {
478: 		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
479: 			return Snapshot{}, wrapError(CodeNotFound, "resolve_alias", "operation alias is not retained", false, err)
480: 		}
481: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("resolve_alias", "resolve operation alias failed", err)
482: 	}
483: 	return r.Snapshot(ctx, runID)
484: }

486: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Claim(ctx context.Context, input Claim) (Attempt, Snapshot, error) {
487: 	if ctx == nil {
488: 		ctx = context.Background()
489: 	}
490: 	if err := input.RunID.Validate(); err != nil {
491: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
492: 	}
493: 	if err := input.Owner.Validate(); err != nil {
494: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
495: 	}
496: 	if err := input.Correlation.Validate(); err != nil {
497: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
498: 	}
499: 	if input.Lease <= 0 {
500: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, invalidField("lease", "must be positive")
501: 	}
502: 	attemptID := input.AttemptID
503: 	var err error
504: 	if attemptID == "" {
505: 		attemptID, err = r.ids.NewAttemptID()
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
508: 		}
509: 	}
510: 	if err := attemptID.Validate(); err != nil {
511: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
512: 	}
513: 	correlation, err := marshalBounded(input.Correlation, MaxSafeValueBytes*8)
514: 	if err != nil {
515: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
516: 	}
517: 	now := r.now()
518: 	leaseAt := now.Add(input.Lease)
519: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
520: 	if err != nil {
521: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
522: 			return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, ctxErr
523: 		}
524: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_begin", "begin owner claim failed", err)
525: 	}
526: 	defer tx.Rollback()
527: 	var lifecycle string
528: 	var currentAttempt sql.NullString
529: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT lifecycle, current_attempt_id FROM runs WHERE run_id = ?`, string(input.RunID)).Scan(&lifecycle, &currentAttempt); err != nil {
530: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, mapRunLookupError("claim", input.RunID, err)
531: 	}
532: 	state := Lifecycle(lifecycle)
533: 	if state.IsTerminal() {
534: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeTerminal, "claim", input.RunID, "terminal run cannot be claimed", false, nil)
535: 	}
536: 	if currentAttempt.Valid && currentAttempt.String != "" {
537: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "claim", input.RunID, "run already has a current owner attempt", false, nil)
538: 	}
539: 	nextLifecycle := LifecycleRunning
540: 	if state == LifecycleCancelling {
541: 		nextLifecycle = LifecycleCancelling
542: 	}
543: 	var ordinal, generation uint64
544: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal), 0) + 1, COALESCE(MAX(fencing_generation), 0) + 1 FROM attempts WHERE run_id = ?`, string(input.RunID)).Scan(&ordinal, &generation); err != nil {
545: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_allocate", "allocate owner fence failed", err)
546: 	}
547: 	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
548: INSERT INTO attempts (
549:     attempt_id, run_id, ordinal, owner_id, fencing_generation, host_digest, boot_id, pid,
550:     process_birth_token, claimed_at, heartbeat_at, lease_expires_at, correlation_json
551: ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
552: 		string(attemptID), string(input.RunID), ordinal, input.Owner.ID, generation,
553: 		input.Owner.Process.HostDigest, input.Owner.Process.BootID, input.Owner.Process.PID,
554: 		input.Owner.Process.BirthToken, formatTime(now), formatTime(now), formatTime(leaseAt), correlation)
555: 	if err != nil {
556: 		if isConstraint(err) {
557: 			return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "claim", input.RunID, "attempt identity or fence already exists", false, err)
558: 		}
559: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim", "persist owner claim failed", err)
560: 	}
561: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
562: UPDATE runs
563: SET current_attempt_id = ?, lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, ?), updated_at = ?
564: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
565: 		string(attemptID), string(nextLifecycle), string(LivenessLive), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), string(input.RunID))
566: 	if err != nil {
567: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_snapshot", "update run owner snapshot failed", err)
568: 	}
569: 	if changed, err := result.RowsAffected(); err != nil || changed != 1 {
570: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "claim", input.RunID, "run owner changed while claiming", true, err)
571: 	}
572: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, input.RunID)
573: 	if err != nil {
574: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
575: 	}
576: 	if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
577: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
578: 	}
579: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
580: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_commit", "commit owner claim failed", err)
581: 	}
582: 	attempt := Attempt{
583: 		ID: attemptID, RunID: input.RunID, Ordinal: ordinal, Owner: input.Owner,
584: 		FencingGeneration: generation, ClaimedAt: now, HeartbeatAt: now,
585: 		LeaseExpiresAt: leaseAt, Correlation: input.Correlation,
586: 	}
587: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run owner claimed",
588: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(input.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(attemptID)},
589: 		LogField{Key: "owner_id", Value: input.Owner.ID}, LogField{Key: "fencing_generation", Value: strconv.FormatUint(generation, 10)},
590: 		LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
591: 	return attempt, snapshot, nil
592: }

608: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Append(ctx context.Context, fence Fence, draft EventDraft) (eventResult Event, snapshotResult Snapshot, resultErr error) {
609: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
610: 	defer func() { r.metrics.append.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
611: 	if ctx == nil {
612: 		ctx = context.Background()
613: 	}
614: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
615: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
616: 	}
617: 	draft = sanitizeEventDraft(NormalizeEventDraft(draft))
618: 	if usage, err := r.storageBytes(); err != nil {
619: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
620: 	} else if usage >= r.retention.HardQuotaBytes && !reservedEventType(draft.Type) {
621: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeQuota, "append_quota", fence.RunID, "hard quota permits only reserved lifecycle recovery writes", true, nil)
622: 	}
623: 	if err := validateEventDraft(draft); err != nil {
624: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
625: 	}
626: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(draft.Payload, MaxSafeValueBytes*8)
627: 	if err != nil {
628: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
629: 	}
630: 	var omissionJSON any
631: 	if draft.Omission != nil {
632: 		encoded, err := marshalBounded(draft.Omission, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
633: 		if err != nil {
634: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
635: 		}
636: 		omissionJSON = encoded
637: 	}
638: 	now := r.now()
639: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
640: 	if err != nil {
641: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
642: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, ctxErr
643: 		}
644: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_begin", "begin event append failed", err)
645: 	}
646: 	defer tx.Rollback()
647: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
648: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
649: 	}
650: 	var lastSequence uint64
651: 	var lifecycle string
652: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT last_sequence, lifecycle FROM runs WHERE run_id = ?`, string(fence.RunID)).Scan(&lastSequence, &lifecycle); err != nil {
653: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, mapRunLookupError("append", fence.RunID, err)
654: 	}
655: 	current := Lifecycle(lifecycle)
656: 	if current.IsTerminal() {
657: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeTerminal, "append", fence.RunID, "terminal run journal is immutable", false, nil)
658: 	}
659: 	nextLifecycle := current
660: 	if draft.Lifecycle != "" {
661: 		if !validActiveTransition(current, draft.Lifecycle) {
662: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeInvariant, "append", fence.RunID, fmt.Sprintf("invalid lifecycle transition %s -> %s", current, draft.Lifecycle), false, nil)
663: 		}
664: 		nextLifecycle = draft.Lifecycle
665: 	}
666: 	sequence := lastSequence + 1
667: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
668: INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, stage_id, task_id, payload_json, omission_json)
669: VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(draft.Type),
670: 		string(fence.AttemptID), draft.Stage, draft.Task, payload, omissionJSON); err != nil {
671: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_event", "persist ordered event failed", err)
672: 	}
673: 	omissionCount := uint64(0)
674: 	if draft.Omission != nil {
675: 		omissionCount = draft.Omission.Count
676: 	}
677: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
678: UPDATE runs SET last_sequence = ?, lifecycle = ?, omission_total = omission_total + ?, updated_at = ?
679: WHERE run_id = ? AND last_sequence = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
680: 		sequence, string(nextLifecycle), omissionCount, formatTime(now), string(fence.RunID), lastSequence, string(fence.AttemptID))
681: 	if err != nil {
682: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_snapshot", "update durable event snapshot failed", err)
683: 	}
684: 	if changed, err := result.RowsAffected(); err != nil || changed != 1 {
685: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeStaleFence, "append", fence.RunID, "event writer lost its authoritative fence", false, err)
686: 	}
687: 	if err := compactRunJournal(ctx, tx, fence.RunID, sequence); err != nil {
688: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
689: 	}
690: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
691: 	if err != nil {
692: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
693: 	}
694: 	if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
695: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
696: 	}
697: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
698: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_commit", "commit ordered event failed", err)
699: 	}
700: 	event := Event{
701: 		RunID: fence.RunID, Sequence: sequence, CommittedAt: now, Type: draft.Type,
702: 		AttemptID: fence.AttemptID, Stage: draft.Stage, Task: draft.Task,
703: 		Payload: clonePayload(draft.Payload), Omission: cloneOmission(draft.Omission),
704: 	}
705: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
706: 	r.log(ctx, LogDebug, "run event committed",
707: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
708: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 10)}, LogField{Key: "event_type", Value: string(draft.Type)},
709: 		LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
710: 	return event, snapshot, nil
711: }

713: func reservedEventType(eventType EventType) bool {
714: 	switch eventType {
715: 	case EventLifecycle, EventWarning, EventCancellation, EventRecovery, EventTerminal, EventOmission:
716: 		return true
717: 	default:
718: 		return false
719: 	}
720: }

722: func (r *SQLiteRepository) ProposeTerminal(ctx context.Context, fence Fence, proposal TerminalProposal) (snapshotResult Snapshot, wonResult bool, resultErr error) {
723: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
724: 	defer func() { r.metrics.terminal.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
725: 	if ctx == nil {
726: 		ctx = context.Background()
727: 	}
728: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
729: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
730: 	}
731: 	if !proposal.Outcome.IsValid() {
732: 		return Snapshot{}, false, invalidField("terminal.outcome", "is unknown")
733: 	}
734: 	if len(proposal.Reason) > MaxSafeValueBytes || len(proposal.ProposedBy) > MaxSafeValueBytes {
735: 		return Snapshot{}, false, invalidField("terminal", "contains an unbounded reason or proposer")
736: 	}
737: 	now := r.now()
738: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
739: 	if err != nil {
740: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
741: 			return Snapshot{}, false, ctxErr
742: 		}
743: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_begin", "begin terminal proposal failed", err)
744: 	}
745: 	defer tx.Rollback()
746: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
747: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
748: 	}
749: 	current, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
750: 	if err != nil {
751: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
752: 	}
753: 	if current.Terminal != nil {
754: 		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
755: 			return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_read_commit", "finish terminal winner read failed", err)
756: 		}
757: 		return current, false, nil
758: 	}
759: 	sequence := current.LastSequence + 1
760: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(map[string]string{"outcome": string(proposal.Outcome), "reason": proposal.Reason}, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
761: 	if err != nil {
762: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
763: 	}
764: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
765: INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, payload_json)
766: VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'terminal', ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(fence.AttemptID), payload); err != nil {
767: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_event", "persist terminal event failed", err)
768: 	}
769: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
770: UPDATE runs
771: SET lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, finished_at = ?, updated_at = ?, last_sequence = ?,
772:     terminal_outcome = ?, terminal_reason = ?, terminal_at = ?, terminal_proposed_by = ?
773: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
774: 		string(proposal.Outcome.Lifecycle()), string(LivenessTerminal), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), sequence,
775: 		string(proposal.Outcome), proposal.Reason, formatTime(now), proposal.ProposedBy,
776: 		string(fence.RunID), string(fence.AttemptID))
777: 	if err != nil {
778: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_cas", "persist terminal winner failed", err)
779: 	}
780: 	changed, err := result.RowsAffected()
781: 	if err != nil {
782: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_cas", "inspect terminal winner failed", err)
783: 	}
784: 	if changed != 1 {
785: 		return Snapshot{}, false, runError(CodeStaleFence, "terminal_cas", fence.RunID, "terminal proposer lost its authoritative fence", false, nil)
786: 	}
787: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE attempts SET outcome = ? WHERE attempt_id = ? AND run_id = ? AND owner_id = ? AND fencing_generation = ?`,
788: 		string(proposal.Outcome), string(fence.AttemptID), string(fence.RunID), fence.OwnerID, fence.FencingGeneration); err != nil {
789: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_attempt", "persist attempt outcome failed", err)
790: 	}
791: 	winner, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
792: 	if err != nil {
793: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
794: 	}
795: 	if err := winner.Validate(); err != nil {
796: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
797: 	}
798: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
799: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_commit", "commit terminal winner failed", err)
800: 	}
801: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
802: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run terminal committed",
803: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
804: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 10)}, LogField{Key: "terminal_outcome", Value: string(proposal.Outcome)},
805: 		LogField{Key: "terminal_winner", Value: "true"})
806: 	return winner, true, nil
807: }

809: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Events(ctx context.Context, runID RunID, after uint64, limit int) ([]Event, error) {
810: 	if err := runID.Validate(); err != nil {
811: 		return nil, err
812: 	}
813: 	if limit == 0 {
814: 		limit = defaultEventPage
815: 	}
816: 	if limit < 1 || limit > maxEventPage {
817: 		return nil, invalidField("event_limit", fmt.Sprintf("must be between 1 and %d", maxEventPage))
818: 	}
819: 	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `
820: SELECT sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, stage_id, task_id, payload_json, omission_json
821: FROM events WHERE run_id = ? AND sequence > ? ORDER BY sequence ASC LIMIT ?`, string(runID), after, limit)
822: 	if err != nil {
823: 		return nil, classifyStoreError("events", "read retained events failed", err)
824: 	}
825: 	defer rows.Close()
826: 	events := make([]Event, 0, limit)
827: 	for rows.Next() {
828: 		var sequence uint64
829: 		var committed, eventType, stage, task, payload string
830: 		var attempt, omission sql.NullString
831: 		if err := rows.Scan(&sequence, &committed, &eventType, &attempt, &stage, &task, &payload, &omission); err != nil {
832: 			return nil, classifyStoreError("events_scan", "decode retained event failed", err)
833: 		}
834: 		committedAt, err := parseTime(committed)
835: 		if err != nil {
836: 			return nil, err
837: 		}
838: 		event := Event{RunID: runID, Sequence: sequence, CommittedAt: committedAt, Type: EventType(eventType), AttemptID: AttemptID(attempt.String), Stage: stage, Task: task}
839: 		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &event.Payload); err != nil {
840: 			return nil, wrapError(CodeCorrupt, "events_decode", "stored event payload is malformed", false, err)
841: 		}
842: 		if omission.Valid {
843: 			event.Omission = &Omission{}
844: 			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(omission.String), event.Omission); err != nil {
845: 				return nil, wrapError(CodeCorrupt, "events_decode", "stored omission metadata is malformed", false, err)
846: 			}
847: 		}
848: 		events = append(events, event)
849: 	}
850: 	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
851: 		return nil, classifyStoreError("events_rows", "read retained events failed", err)
852: 	}
853: 	return events, nil
854: }

183: 		return "", classifyStoreError("inspect_database", "inspect run-control database failed", err)
184: 	case info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular():
185: 		return "", invalidField("run_control_database", "must be a regular file, not a symlink")
186: 	}
187: 	if err := enforcePrivateMode(path, 0o600); err != nil {
188: 		return "", err
189: 	}
190: 	return path, nil
191: }

193: func enforcePrivateMode(path string, want fs.FileMode) error {
194: 	if err := os.Chmod(path, want); err != nil {
195: 		return classifyStoreError("set_permissions", "set private run-control permissions failed", err)
196: 	}
197: 	info, err := os.Stat(path)
198: 	if err != nil {
199: 		return classifyStoreError("verify_permissions", "verify run-control permissions failed", err)
200: 	}
201: 	if got := info.Mode().Perm(); got != want {
202: 		return wrapError(CodePermission, "verify_permissions", fmt.Sprintf("private permissions are %04o; require %04o", got, want), false, nil)
203: 	}
204: 	return nil
205: }

207: func verifyPragmas(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB) error {
208: 	checks := []struct {
209: 		name string
210: 		want string
211: 	}{
212: 		{name: "journal_mode", want: "wal"},
213: 		{name: "synchronous", want: "2"},
214: 		{name: "foreign_keys", want: "1"},
215: 		{name: "busy_timeout", want: "5000"},
216: 	}
217: 	for _, check := range checks {
218: 		var got string
219: 		if err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "PRAGMA "+check.name).Scan(&got); err != nil {
220: 			return classifyStoreError("verify_pragma", "verify required SQLite durability policy failed", err)
221: 		}
222: 		if !strings.EqualFold(got, check.want) {
223: 			return wrapError(CodeInvariant, "verify_pragma", fmt.Sprintf("SQLite %s=%s; require %s", check.name, got, check.want), false, nil)
224: 		}
225: 	}
226: 	return nil
227: }

344: func createInitialSchema(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, migratedAt time.Time) error {

348: 			return ctxErr
349: 		}
350: 		return classifyStoreError("begin_schema", "begin run-control schema transaction failed", err)
351: 	}
352: 	defer tx.Rollback()
353: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, initialSchema); err != nil {
354: 		return classifyStoreError("create_schema", "create run-control schema failed", err)
355: 	}
356: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT OR REPLACE INTO app_schema (component, version, migrated_at) VALUES ('run_control', 1, ?)`, formatTime(migratedAt)); err != nil {
357: 		return classifyStoreError("record_schema", "record run-control schema version failed", err)
358: 	}

360: 		return classifyStoreError("record_user_version", "record SQLite user version failed", err)
361: 	}
362: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
363: 		return classifyStoreError("commit_schema", "commit run-control schema failed", err)
364: 	}
365: 	return nil
366: }

378: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Accept(ctx context.Context, input Acceptance) (snapshotResult Snapshot, resultErr error) {
379: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
380: 	defer func() { r.metrics.acceptance.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
381: 	if ctx == nil {
382: 		ctx = context.Background()
383: 	}
384: 	if usage, err := r.storageBytes(); err != nil {
385: 		return Snapshot{}, err
386: 	} else if usage >= r.retention.HardQuotaBytes*80/100 {
387: 		if _, compactErr := r.Compact(ctx, 64); compactErr != nil {
388: 			return Snapshot{}, compactErr
389: 		}
390: 	}
391: 	if usage, err := r.storageBytes(); err != nil {
392: 		return Snapshot{}, err
393: 	} else if usage >= r.softQuota {
394: 		return Snapshot{}, wrapError(CodeQuota, "accept_quota", "run-control soft quota prevents new acceptance", true, nil)
395: 	}
396: 	if err := input.Target.Validate(); err != nil {
397: 		return Snapshot{}, err
398: 	}
399: 	if err := input.Correlation.Validate(); err != nil {
400: 		return Snapshot{}, err
401: 	}
402: 	if len(input.ProductStatus) > MaxSafeValueBytes || len(input.ConfirmationDigest) > MaxSafeValueBytes {
403: 		return Snapshot{}, invalidField("acceptance", "contains an unbounded status or confirmation digest")
404: 	}
405: 	runID := input.RunID
406: 	var err error
407: 	if runID == "" {
408: 		runID, err = r.ids.NewRunID()
409: 		if err != nil {
410: 			return Snapshot{}, err
411: 		}
412: 	}
413: 	if err := runID.Validate(); err != nil {
414: 		return Snapshot{}, err
415: 	}
416: 	correlation, err := marshalBounded(input.Correlation, MaxSafeValueBytes*8)
417: 	if err != nil {
418: 		return Snapshot{}, err
419: 	}
420: 	now := r.now()
421: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
422: 	if err != nil {
423: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
424: 			return Snapshot{}, ctxErr
425: 		}
426: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept_begin", "begin durable acceptance failed", err)
427: 	}
428: 	defer tx.Rollback()
429: 	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
430: INSERT INTO runs (
431:     run_id, target_kind, operation_kind, project_id, sprint_id, study_id, stage_id, task_id,
432:     lifecycle, liveness, record_state, accepted_at, updated_at, correlation_json,
433:     product_status, confirmation_digest, cancellation_state
434: ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
435: 		string(runID), input.Target.Kind, input.Target.Operation, input.Target.Project, input.Target.Sprint,
436: 		input.Target.Study, input.Target.Stage, input.Target.Task, string(LifecycleAccepted), string(LivenessUnknown),
437: 		string(RecordFull), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), correlation, input.ProductStatus,
438: 		input.ConfirmationDigest, string(CancellationNone))
439: 	if err != nil {
440: 		if isConstraint(err) {
441: 			return Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "accept", runID, "run identity or acceptance key already exists", false, err)
442: 		}
443: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept", "persist durable acceptance failed", err)
444: 	}
445: 	if input.OperationAlias != "" {
446: 		if len(input.OperationAlias) > MaxSafeValueBytes || strings.ContainsAny(input.OperationAlias, "\x00\r\n") {
447: 			return Snapshot{}, invalidField("operation_alias", "must be a bounded opaque value")
448: 		}
449: 		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO operation_aliases (alias_id, run_id, alias_kind, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'operation', ?)`, input.OperationAlias, string(runID), formatTime(now)); err != nil {
450: 			if isConstraint(err) {
451: 				return Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "accept_alias", runID, "operation alias already exists", false, err)
452: 			}
453: 			return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept_alias", "persist operation alias failed", err)
454: 		}
455: 	}
456: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, runID)
457: 	if err != nil {
458: 		return Snapshot{}, err
459: 	}
460: 	if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
461: 		return Snapshot{}, err
462: 	}
463: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
464: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("accept_commit", "commit durable acceptance failed", err)
465: 	}
466: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run accepted",
467: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(runID)}, LogField{Key: "target_kind", Value: input.Target.Kind},
468: 		LogField{Key: "operation", Value: input.Target.Operation}, LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
469: 	return snapshot, nil
470: }

472: func (r *SQLiteRepository) ResolveOperationAlias(ctx context.Context, alias string) (Snapshot, error) {
473: 	if strings.TrimSpace(alias) == "" || len(alias) > MaxSafeValueBytes || strings.ContainsAny(alias, "\x00\r\n") {
474: 		return Snapshot{}, invalidField("operation_alias", "must be a bounded opaque value")
475: 	}
476: 	var runID RunID
477: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT run_id FROM operation_aliases WHERE alias_id = ?`, alias).Scan(&runID); err != nil {
478: 		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
479: 			return Snapshot{}, wrapError(CodeNotFound, "resolve_alias", "operation alias is not retained", false, err)
480: 		}
481: 		return Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("resolve_alias", "resolve operation alias failed", err)
482: 	}
483: 	return r.Snapshot(ctx, runID)
484: }

486: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Claim(ctx context.Context, input Claim) (Attempt, Snapshot, error) {
487: 	if ctx == nil {
488: 		ctx = context.Background()
489: 	}
490: 	if err := input.RunID.Validate(); err != nil {
491: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
492: 	}
493: 	if err := input.Owner.Validate(); err != nil {
494: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
495: 	}
496: 	if err := input.Correlation.Validate(); err != nil {
497: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
498: 	}
499: 	if input.Lease <= 0 {
500: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, invalidField("lease", "must be positive")
501: 	}
502: 	attemptID := input.AttemptID
503: 	var err error
504: 	if attemptID == "" {
505: 		attemptID, err = r.ids.NewAttemptID()
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
508: 		}
509: 	}
510: 	if err := attemptID.Validate(); err != nil {
511: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
512: 	}
513: 	correlation, err := marshalBounded(input.Correlation, MaxSafeValueBytes*8)
514: 	if err != nil {
515: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
516: 	}
517: 	now := r.now()
518: 	leaseAt := now.Add(input.Lease)
519: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
520: 	if err != nil {
521: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
522: 			return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, ctxErr
523: 		}
524: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_begin", "begin owner claim failed", err)
525: 	}
526: 	defer tx.Rollback()
527: 	var lifecycle string
528: 	var currentAttempt sql.NullString
529: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT lifecycle, current_attempt_id FROM runs WHERE run_id = ?`, string(input.RunID)).Scan(&lifecycle, &currentAttempt); err != nil {
530: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, mapRunLookupError("claim", input.RunID, err)
531: 	}
532: 	state := Lifecycle(lifecycle)
533: 	if state.IsTerminal() {
534: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeTerminal, "claim", input.RunID, "terminal run cannot be claimed", false, nil)
535: 	}
536: 	if currentAttempt.Valid && currentAttempt.String != "" {
537: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "claim", input.RunID, "run already has a current owner attempt", false, nil)
538: 	}
539: 	nextLifecycle := LifecycleRunning
540: 	if state == LifecycleCancelling {
541: 		nextLifecycle = LifecycleCancelling
542: 	}
543: 	var ordinal, generation uint64
544: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal), 0) + 1, COALESCE(MAX(fencing_generation), 0) + 1 FROM attempts WHERE run_id = ?`, string(input.RunID)).Scan(&ordinal, &generation); err != nil {
545: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_allocate", "allocate owner fence failed", err)
546: 	}
547: 	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
548: INSERT INTO attempts (
549:     attempt_id, run_id, ordinal, owner_id, fencing_generation, host_digest, boot_id, pid,
550:     process_birth_token, claimed_at, heartbeat_at, lease_expires_at, correlation_json
551: ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
552: 		string(attemptID), string(input.RunID), ordinal, input.Owner.ID, generation,
553: 		input.Owner.Process.HostDigest, input.Owner.Process.BootID, input.Owner.Process.PID,
554: 		input.Owner.Process.BirthToken, formatTime(now), formatTime(now), formatTime(leaseAt), correlation)
555: 	if err != nil {
556: 		if isConstraint(err) {
557: 			return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "claim", input.RunID, "attempt identity or fence already exists", false, err)
558: 		}
559: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim", "persist owner claim failed", err)
560: 	}
561: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
562: UPDATE runs
563: SET current_attempt_id = ?, lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, ?), updated_at = ?
564: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
565: 		string(attemptID), string(nextLifecycle), string(LivenessLive), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), string(input.RunID))
566: 	if err != nil {
567: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_snapshot", "update run owner snapshot failed", err)
568: 	}
569: 	if changed, err := result.RowsAffected(); err != nil || changed != 1 {
570: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeConflict, "claim", input.RunID, "run owner changed while claiming", true, err)
571: 	}
572: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, input.RunID)
573: 	if err != nil {
574: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
575: 	}
576: 	if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
577: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, err
578: 	}
579: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
580: 		return Attempt{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("claim_commit", "commit owner claim failed", err)
581: 	}
582: 	attempt := Attempt{
583: 		ID: attemptID, RunID: input.RunID, Ordinal: ordinal, Owner: input.Owner,
584: 		FencingGeneration: generation, ClaimedAt: now, HeartbeatAt: now,
585: 		LeaseExpiresAt: leaseAt, Correlation: input.Correlation,
586: 	}
587: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run owner claimed",
588: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(input.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(attemptID)},
589: 		LogField{Key: "owner_id", Value: input.Owner.ID}, LogField{Key: "fencing_generation", Value: strconv.FormatUint(generation, 10)},
590: 		LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
591: 	return attempt, snapshot, nil
592: }

608: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Append(ctx context.Context, fence Fence, draft EventDraft) (eventResult Event, snapshotResult Snapshot, resultErr error) {
609: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
610: 	defer func() { r.metrics.append.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
611: 	if ctx == nil {
612: 		ctx = context.Background()
613: 	}
614: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
615: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
616: 	}
617: 	draft = sanitizeEventDraft(NormalizeEventDraft(draft))
618: 	if usage, err := r.storageBytes(); err != nil {
619: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
620: 	} else if usage >= r.retention.HardQuotaBytes && !reservedEventType(draft.Type) {
621: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeQuota, "append_quota", fence.RunID, "hard quota permits only reserved lifecycle recovery writes", true, nil)
622: 	}
623: 	if err := validateEventDraft(draft); err != nil {
624: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
625: 	}
626: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(draft.Payload, MaxSafeValueBytes*8)
627: 	if err != nil {
628: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
629: 	}
630: 	var omissionJSON any
631: 	if draft.Omission != nil {
632: 		encoded, err := marshalBounded(draft.Omission, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
633: 		if err != nil {
634: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
635: 		}
636: 		omissionJSON = encoded
637: 	}
638: 	now := r.now()
639: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
640: 	if err != nil {
641: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
642: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, ctxErr
643: 		}
644: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_begin", "begin event append failed", err)
645: 	}
646: 	defer tx.Rollback()
647: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
648: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
649: 	}
650: 	var lastSequence uint64
651: 	var lifecycle string
652: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT last_sequence, lifecycle FROM runs WHERE run_id = ?`, string(fence.RunID)).Scan(&lastSequence, &lifecycle); err != nil {
653: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, mapRunLookupError("append", fence.RunID, err)
654: 	}
655: 	current := Lifecycle(lifecycle)
656: 	if current.IsTerminal() {
657: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeTerminal, "append", fence.RunID, "terminal run journal is immutable", false, nil)
658: 	}
659: 	nextLifecycle := current
660: 	if draft.Lifecycle != "" {
661: 		if !validActiveTransition(current, draft.Lifecycle) {
662: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeInvariant, "append", fence.RunID, fmt.Sprintf("invalid lifecycle transition %s -> %s", current, draft.Lifecycle), false, nil)
663: 		}
664: 		nextLifecycle = draft.Lifecycle
665: 	}
666: 	sequence := lastSequence + 1
667: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
668: INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, stage_id, task_id, payload_json, omission_json)
669: VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(draft.Type),
670: 		string(fence.AttemptID), draft.Stage, draft.Task, payload, omissionJSON); err != nil {
671: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_event", "persist ordered event failed", err)
672: 	}
673: 	omissionCount := uint64(0)
674: 	if draft.Omission != nil {
675: 		omissionCount = draft.Omission.Count
676: 	}
677: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
678: UPDATE runs SET last_sequence = ?, lifecycle = ?, omission_total = omission_total + ?, updated_at = ?
679: WHERE run_id = ? AND last_sequence = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
680: 		sequence, string(nextLifecycle), omissionCount, formatTime(now), string(fence.RunID), lastSequence, string(fence.AttemptID))
681: 	if err != nil {
682: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_snapshot", "update durable event snapshot failed", err)
683: 	}
684: 	if changed, err := result.RowsAffected(); err != nil || changed != 1 {
685: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeStaleFence, "append", fence.RunID, "event writer lost its authoritative fence", false, err)
686: 	}
687: 	if err := compactRunJournal(ctx, tx, fence.RunID, sequence); err != nil {
688: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
689: 	}
690: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
691: 	if err != nil {
692: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
693: 	}
694: 	if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
695: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
696: 	}
697: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
698: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_commit", "commit ordered event failed", err)
699: 	}
700: 	event := Event{
701: 		RunID: fence.RunID, Sequence: sequence, CommittedAt: now, Type: draft.Type,
702: 		AttemptID: fence.AttemptID, Stage: draft.Stage, Task: draft.Task,
703: 		Payload: clonePayload(draft.Payload), Omission: cloneOmission(draft.Omission),
704: 	}
705: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
706: 	r.log(ctx, LogDebug, "run event committed",
707: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
708: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 10)}, LogField{Key: "event_type", Value: string(draft.Type)},
709: 		LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
710: 	return event, snapshot, nil
711: }

722: func (r *SQLiteRepository) ProposeTerminal(ctx context.Context, fence Fence, proposal TerminalProposal) (snapshotResult Snapshot, wonResult bool, resultErr error) {
723: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
724: 	defer func() { r.metrics.terminal.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
725: 	if ctx == nil {
726: 		ctx = context.Background()
727: 	}
728: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
729: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
730: 	}
731: 	if !proposal.Outcome.IsValid() {
732: 		return Snapshot{}, false, invalidField("terminal.outcome", "is unknown")
733: 	}
734: 	if len(proposal.Reason) > MaxSafeValueBytes || len(proposal.ProposedBy) > MaxSafeValueBytes {
735: 		return Snapshot{}, false, invalidField("terminal", "contains an unbounded reason or proposer")
736: 	}
737: 	now := r.now()
738: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
739: 	if err != nil {
740: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
741: 			return Snapshot{}, false, ctxErr
742: 		}
743: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_begin", "begin terminal proposal failed", err)
744: 	}
745: 	defer tx.Rollback()
746: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
747: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
748: 	}
749: 	current, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
750: 	if err != nil {
751: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
752: 	}
753: 	if current.Terminal != nil {
754: 		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
755: 			return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_read_commit", "finish terminal winner read failed", err)
756: 		}
757: 		return current, false, nil
758: 	}
759: 	sequence := current.LastSequence + 1
760: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(map[string]string{"outcome": string(proposal.Outcome), "reason": proposal.Reason}, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
761: 	if err != nil {
762: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
763: 	}
764: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
765: INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, payload_json)
766: VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'terminal', ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(fence.AttemptID), payload); err != nil {
767: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_event", "persist terminal event failed", err)
768: 	}
769: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
770: UPDATE runs
771: SET lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, finished_at = ?, updated_at = ?, last_sequence = ?,
772:     terminal_outcome = ?, terminal_reason = ?, terminal_at = ?, terminal_proposed_by = ?
773: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
774: 		string(proposal.Outcome.Lifecycle()), string(LivenessTerminal), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), sequence,
775: 		string(proposal.Outcome), proposal.Reason, formatTime(now), proposal.ProposedBy,
776: 		string(fence.RunID), string(fence.AttemptID))
777: 	if err != nil {
778: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_cas", "persist terminal winner failed", err)
779: 	}
780: 	changed, err := result.RowsAffected()
781: 	if err != nil {
782: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_cas", "inspect terminal winner failed", err)
783: 	}
784: 	if changed != 1 {
785: 		return Snapshot{}, false, runError(CodeStaleFence, "terminal_cas", fence.RunID, "terminal proposer lost its authoritative fence", false, nil)
786: 	}
787: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE attempts SET outcome = ? WHERE attempt_id = ? AND run_id = ? AND owner_id = ? AND fencing_generation = ?`,
788: 		string(proposal.Outcome), string(fence.AttemptID), string(fence.RunID), fence.OwnerID, fence.FencingGeneration); err != nil {
789: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_attempt", "persist attempt outcome failed", err)
790: 	}
791: 	winner, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
792: 	if err != nil {
793: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
794: 	}
795: 	if err := winner.Validate(); err != nil {
796: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
797: 	}
798: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
799: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_commit", "commit terminal winner failed", err)
800: 	}
801: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
802: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run terminal committed",
803: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
804: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 10)}, LogField{Key: "terminal_outcome", Value: string(proposal.Outcome)},
805: 		LogField{Key: "terminal_winner", Value: "true"})
806: 	return winner, true, nil
807: }

809: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Events(ctx context.Context, runID RunID, after uint64, limit int) ([]Event, error) {
810: 	if err := runID.Validate(); err != nil {
811: 		return nil, err
812: 	}
813: 	if limit == 0 {
814: 		limit = defaultEventPage
815: 	}
816: 	if limit < 1 || limit > maxEventPage {
817: 		return nil, invalidField("event_limit", fmt.Sprintf("must be between 1 and %d", maxEventPage))
818: 	}
819: 	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `
820: SELECT sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, stage_id, task_id, payload_json, omission_json
821: FROM events WHERE run_id = ? AND sequence > ? ORDER BY sequence ASC LIMIT ?`, string(runID), after, limit)
822: 	if err != nil {
823: 		return nil, classifyStoreError("events", "read retained events failed", err)
824: 	}
825: 	defer rows.Close()
826: 	events := make([]Event, 0, limit)
827: 	for rows.Next() {
828: 		var sequence uint64
829: 		var committed, eventType, stage, task, payload string
830: 		var attempt, omission sql.NullString
831: 		if err := rows.Scan(&sequence, &committed, &eventType, &attempt, &stage, &task, &payload, &omission); err != nil {
832: 			return nil, classifyStoreError("events_scan", "decode retained event failed", err)
833: 		}
834: 		committedAt, err := parseTime(committed)
835: 		if err != nil {
836: 			return nil, err
837: 		}
838: 		event := Event{RunID: runID, Sequence: sequence, CommittedAt: committedAt, Type: EventType(eventType), AttemptID: AttemptID(attempt.String), Stage: stage, Task: task}
839: 		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &event.Payload); err != nil {
840: 			return nil, wrapError(CodeCorrupt, "events_decode", "stored event payload is malformed", false, err)
841: 		}
842: 		if omission.Valid {
843: 			event.Omission = &Omission{}
844: 			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(omission.String), event.Omission); err != nil {
845: 				return nil, wrapError(CodeCorrupt, "events_decode", "stored omission metadata is malformed", false, err)
846: 			}
847: 		}
848: 		events = append(events, event)
849: 	}
850: 	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
851: 		return nil, classifyStoreError("events_rows", "read retained events failed", err)
852: 	}
853: 	return events, nil
854: }

856: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Health(ctx context.Context) (Health, error) {
857: 	health := Health{Status: HealthOK, DatabasePath: DatabaseRelativePath, BusyTimeout: BusyTimeout, SoftQuotaBytes: r.softQuota, HardQuotaBytes: r.retention.HardQuotaBytes, ReservedHeadroomBytes: ReservedHeadroomBytes}
858: 	health.Metrics = r.metrics.snapshot()
859: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "PRAGMA journal_mode").Scan(&health.JournalMode); err != nil {
860: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read journal mode failed", err)
861: 	}
862: 	var synchronous, foreignKeys int
863: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "PRAGMA synchronous").Scan(&synchronous); err != nil {
864: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read synchronous mode failed", err)
865: 	}
866: 	health.Synchronous = strconv.Itoa(synchronous)
867: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "PRAGMA foreign_keys").Scan(&foreignKeys); err != nil {
868: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read foreign-key policy failed", err)
869: 	}
870: 	health.ForeignKeys = foreignKeys == 1
871: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE lifecycle IN ('accepted','queued','running','cancelling')`).Scan(&health.ActiveRuns); err != nil {
872: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read active-run projection failed", err)
873: 	}
874: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE terminal_outcome IS NULL AND liveness = 'stalled'`).Scan(&health.StalledRuns); err != nil {
875: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read stalled-run projection failed", err)
876: 	}
877: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE cancellation_state = 'uncertain'`).Scan(&health.CancellationUncertain); err != nil {
878: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read cancellation-uncertainty projection failed", err)
879: 	}
880: 	acceptedPredicate, acceptedArgs := r.expiredTimestampPredicate("runs.accepted_at", ReconciliationGrace)
881: 	leasePredicate, leaseArgs := r.expiredLeasePredicate(ReconciliationGrace)
882: 	backlogArgs := append(acceptedArgs, leaseArgs...)
883: 	backlogWhere := `runs.terminal_outcome IS NULL AND ((runs.current_attempt_id IS NULL AND ` + acceptedPredicate + `)
884: OR (runs.current_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND ` + leasePredicate + `))`
885: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs LEFT JOIN attempts ON attempts.attempt_id = runs.current_attempt_id
886: WHERE `+backlogWhere, backlogArgs...).Scan(&health.ReconciliationBacklog); err != nil {
887: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read reconciliation backlog failed", err)
888: 	}
889: 	var oldestLease sql.NullString
890: 	if err := r.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN runs.current_attempt_id IS NULL THEN runs.accepted_at ELSE attempts.lease_expires_at END)
891: FROM runs LEFT JOIN attempts ON attempts.attempt_id = runs.current_attempt_id WHERE `+backlogWhere, backlogArgs...).Scan(&oldestLease); err != nil {
892: 		return Health{}, classifyStoreError("health", "read reconciliation backlog age failed", err)
893: 	}
894: 	if oldestLease.Valid {
895: 		oldest, err := parseTime(oldestLease.String)
896: 		if err != nil {
897: 			return Health{}, err
898: 		}
899: 		health.OldestBacklogAge = max(0, r.now().Sub(oldest))
900: 	}
901: 	storageBytes, err := r.storageBytes()
902: 	if err != nil {
903: 		return Health{}, err
904: 	}
905: 	health.StorageBytes = storageBytes
906: 	if health.StorageBytes >= health.HardQuotaBytes {
907: 		health.Status = HealthFailed
908: 		health.Diagnostics = append(health.Diagnostics, "hard quota reached; active owners must stop")
909: 	} else if health.StorageBytes >= health.SoftQuotaBytes {
910: 		health.Status = HealthDegraded
911: 		health.Diagnostics = append(health.Diagnostics, "soft quota reached; new run acceptance is paused")
912: 	}
913: 	return health, nil
914: }

920: func loadSnapshot(ctx context.Context, q queryRower, runID RunID) (Snapshot, error) {
921: 	var snapshot Snapshot
922: 	var lifecycle, liveness, recordState, accepted, updated string
923: 	var started, finished, currentAttempt sql.NullString
924: 	var correlationJSON string
925: 	var historyComplete int
926: 	var cancellationState, cancellationReason string
927: 	var cancellationRequested, cancellationAcknowledged sql.NullString
928: 	var terminalOutcome, terminalAt sql.NullString
929: 	var terminalReason, terminalProposedBy string
930: 	err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, `
931: SELECT run_id, target_kind, operation_kind, project_id, sprint_id, study_id, stage_id, task_id,
932:        lifecycle, liveness, record_state, accepted_at, updated_at, started_at, finished_at,
933:        current_attempt_id, last_sequence, oldest_retained_sequence, history_complete, omission_total,
934:        correlation_json, product_status, cancellation_state, cancellation_reason,
935:        cancellation_requested_at, cancellation_acknowledged_at,
936:        terminal_outcome, terminal_reason, terminal_at, terminal_proposed_by
937: FROM runs WHERE run_id = ?`, string(runID)).Scan(
938: 		&snapshot.RunID, &snapshot.Target.Kind, &snapshot.Target.Operation, &snapshot.Target.Project,
939: 		&snapshot.Target.Sprint, &snapshot.Target.Study, &snapshot.Target.Stage, &snapshot.Target.Task,
940: 		&lifecycle, &liveness, &recordState, &accepted, &updated, &started, &finished,
941: 		&currentAttempt, &snapshot.LastSequence, &snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence, &historyComplete,
942: 		&snapshot.OmissionTotal, &correlationJSON, &snapshot.ProductStatus, &cancellationState,
943: 		&cancellationReason, &cancellationRequested, &cancellationAcknowledged,
944: 		&terminalOutcome, &terminalReason, &terminalAt, &terminalProposedBy)
945: 	if err != nil {
946: 		return Snapshot{}, mapRunLookupError("snapshot", runID, err)
947: 	}
948: 	snapshot.Lifecycle = Lifecycle(lifecycle)
949: 	snapshot.Liveness = Liveness(liveness)
950: 	snapshot.RecordState = RecordState(recordState)
951: 	snapshot.CurrentAttemptID = AttemptID(currentAttempt.String)
952: 	snapshot.HistoryComplete = historyComplete == 1
953: 	if snapshot.AcceptedAt, err = parseTime(accepted); err != nil {
954: 		return Snapshot{}, err
955: 	}
956: 	if snapshot.UpdatedAt, err = parseTime(updated); err != nil {
957: 		return Snapshot{}, err
958: 	}
959: 	if snapshot.StartedAt, err = parseOptionalTime(started); err != nil {
960: 		return Snapshot{}, err
961: 	}
962: 	if snapshot.FinishedAt, err = parseOptionalTime(finished); err != nil {
963: 		return Snapshot{}, err
964: 	}
965: 	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(correlationJSON), &snapshot.Correlation); err != nil {
966: 		return Snapshot{}, wrapError(CodeCorrupt, "snapshot_decode", "stored correlation is malformed", false, err)
967: 	}
968: 	snapshot.Cancellation = Cancellation{State: CancellationState(cancellationState), Reason: cancellationReason}
969: 	if snapshot.Cancellation.RequestedAt, err = parseOptionalTime(cancellationRequested); err != nil {
970: 		return Snapshot{}, err
971: 	}
972: 	if snapshot.Cancellation.AcknowledgedAt, err = parseOptionalTime(cancellationAcknowledged); err != nil {
973: 		return Snapshot{}, err
974: 	}
975: 	if terminalOutcome.Valid {
976: 		wonAt, err := parseTime(terminalAt.String)
977: 		if err != nil {
978: 			return Snapshot{}, err
979: 		}
980: 		snapshot.Terminal = &Terminal{Outcome: TerminalOutcome(terminalOutcome.String), Reason: terminalReason, WonAt: wonAt, ProposedBy: terminalProposedBy}
981: 	}
982: 	return snapshot, nil
983: }

985: func verifyFence(ctx context.Context, q queryRower, fence Fence) error {
986: 	var ownerID string
987: 	var generation uint64
988: 	var currentAttempt sql.NullString
989: 	err := q.QueryRowContext(ctx, `
990: SELECT attempts.owner_id, attempts.fencing_generation, runs.current_attempt_id
991: FROM attempts JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = attempts.run_id
992: WHERE attempts.run_id = ? AND attempts.attempt_id = ?`, string(fence.RunID), string(fence.AttemptID)).Scan(&ownerID, &generation, &currentAttempt)
993: 	if err != nil {
994: 		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
995: 			return runError(CodeStaleFence, "verify_fence", fence.RunID, "owner attempt is not authoritative", false, err)
996: 		}
997: 		return classifyStoreError("verify_fence", "verify owner fence failed", err)
998: 	}
999: 	if ownerID != fence.OwnerID || generation != fence.FencingGeneration || !currentAttempt.Valid || currentAttempt.String != string(fence.AttemptID) {
1000: 		return runError(CodeStaleFence, "verify_fence", fence.RunID, "owner attempt is not authoritative", false, nil)
1001: 	}
1002: 	return nil
1003: }

1005: func validateEventDraft(draft EventDraft) error {
1006: 	if !draft.Type.IsValid() {
1007: 		return invalidField("event.type", "is unknown")
1008: 	}
1009: 	if !draft.Scope.IsValid() {
1010: 		return invalidField("event.scope", "is unknown")
1011: 	}
1012: 	if draft.Lifecycle != "" && (!draft.Lifecycle.IsValid() || draft.Lifecycle.IsTerminal()) {
1013: 		return invalidField("event.lifecycle", "must be an active lifecycle; terminal state uses terminal arbitration")
1014: 	}
1015: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"stage": draft.Stage, "task": draft.Task} {
1016: 		if len(value) > MaxTargetFieldBytes || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\x00\r\n") {
1017: 			return invalidField("event."+name, "must be a bounded safe value")
1018: 		}
1019: 	}
1020: 	for key, value := range draft.Payload {
1021: 		if key == "" || len(key) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(key, "\x00\r\n") || len(value) > MaxSafeValueBytes || strings.ContainsRune(value, '\x00') {
1022: 			return invalidField("event.payload", "must contain bounded safe string fields")
1023: 		}
1024: 	}
1025: 	if draft.Omission != nil && (draft.Omission.Count == 0 || len(draft.Omission.Reason) > MaxSafeValueBytes) {
1026: 		return invalidField("event.omission", "requires a bounded reason and positive count")
1027: 	}
1028: 	return nil
1029: }

1031: func validActiveTransition(from, to Lifecycle) bool {
1032: 	if from == to {
1033: 		return true
1034: 	}
1035: 	switch from {
1036: 	case LifecycleAccepted:
1037: 		return to == LifecycleQueued || to == LifecycleRunning || to == LifecycleCancelling
1038: 	case LifecycleQueued:
1039: 		return to == LifecycleRunning || to == LifecycleCancelling
1040: 	case LifecycleRunning:
1041: 		return to == LifecycleCancelling
1042: 	case LifecycleCancelling:
1043: 		return false
1044: 	default:
1045: 		return false
1046: 	}
1047: }

1088: func classifyStoreError(operation, message string, err error) error {
1089: 	type sqliteCoder interface{ Code() int }
1090: 	var coded sqliteCoder
1091: 	if errors.As(err, &coded) {
